message: No detected untrusted source handling: Although download_veris_csv is imported suggesting remote data fetching, no checksum verification, signed URL validation, or source authentication is visible in the provided code slice.

No detected label flipping detection: The check_y_statistics function is called to verify label distributions, but it only checks for small sample size or degenerate class statistics (error_class tag), not for label-flipping anomalies or label noise detection against an expected set.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples present anywhere in the data preparation pipeline code shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using sklearn/LightGBM estimators and registers them via MLflow, but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed when loading any pretrained weights or serialized model artifacts.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation code.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, or shape/range guards are visible on the inference data-flow path; the pipeline accepts inputs without any defensive validation.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model output probabilities or predictions (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds [0,1]) before results are returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification pipeline (LightGBM, RandomForest, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
